response.sql: SELECT AVG(TG) as average_triglyceride, AVG(WBC) as average_wbc FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC >= 6.5

assumptions.assumption: "6.5 as the cutoff for a high white blood cell count" is interpreted as WBC >= 6.5 (inclusive of the cutoff value)

alternatives.interpretation: If the cutoff is exclusive (values strictly greater than 6.5 are considered high), use WBC > 6.5
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(TG) as average_triglyceride, AVG(WBC) as average_wbc FROM Laboratory WHERE WBC > 6.5
